data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Onida was a nymph who personified endurance and perseverance. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'onos,' meaning 'struggle.' In Christian tradition, Onida represents the unwavering faith and determination of those who face trials and tribulations. The name Onida carries the meaning “Struggle, Endurance” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Onida usually hope their child will grow to embody struggle, endurance and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Onida belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Struggle, Endurance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Onida total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
